sections.title: Beyond Hardware: Adaptive Algorithmic Control by State-Proxy Equalization
sections.abstract: Adaptive Algorithmic Control allocates computational effort using a state-derived proxy for evolving quantum difficulty.
sections.claimed_result: The authors report 22% to more than 100,000% improvements in low-energy sampling probabilities under matched budgets.

sections.title: Nonlinear electron-phonon interactions from first principles
sections.abstract: A first-principles method computes arbitrary-order nonlinear electron-phonon interactions.
sections.claimed_result: Second-order couplings improve quantitative polaron formation energies and hopping barriers.
sections.caveat: Higher-order and large-system scaling remains to be established.

sections.title: The Equivalence Principle in the Dark Sector in light of DESI
sections.abstract: A dark-sector equivalence-principle violation is fitted to DESI and CMB data.
sections.claimed_result: The authors find a possible dark force at approximately 2.5–3 sigma depending on the dataset combination.
sections.caveat: The result is a preliminary, model-dependent statistical tension, not a discovery.

sections.title: Cosmological Constrained Axion-Portal Inelastic Dark Matter for the LZ Event
sections.abstract: A two-state axion-portal inelastic dark-matter model is evolved cosmologically and compared with the LZ candidate recoil.
sections.claimed_result: Different ALP couplings select different surviving excited-state fractions and recoil directions near 250 keV.
sections.caveat: The LZ event is a candidate and requires confirmation and complementary tests.

sections.title: A Fully Analytic Expression for the 2PN N-Body Hamiltonian
sections.abstract: The remaining integral in the general nonspinning 2PN ADM N-body Hamiltonian is evaluated analytically.
sections.claimed_result: The authors obtain a closed-form Hamiltonian and validate it numerically against the integral representation.
sections.caveat: The complete derivation is deferred to an extended version; spin and higher-PN effects are out of scope.

sections.title: Evaluating Verified Autonomy in Quantum Engineering
sections.abstract: Quantum-Harbor and QIQCBench provide a virtual laboratory and 49-task benchmark for verified quantum-engineering autonomy.
sections.claimed_result: Evaluation across 17 agentic systems finds wide variation and a gap between capability demonstrations and reliable operation.
sections.caveat: Benchmark results may not generalize to physical hardware or unseen workflows.

sections.title: Query-optimal quantum simulation of Lindblad evolution
sections.abstract: An algorithm achieves additive dependence on evolution time and precision for general Lindblad simulation in the block-encoding model.
sections.claimed_result: The authors close a query-complexity gap and obtain optimal additive query dependence.
sections.caveat: Gate complexity remains higher than existing algorithms.
